FUN_1000b110.role: recursive quicksort of the 16-byte position records {double position; int32 word_index; int32 pad} by position (F-58's 'record initializer' guess was WRONG)
FUN_1000b110.called_from: FUN_100060e0 once per band (0x10006214 loop) before value placement - pulses consumed in ascending position order
FUN_1000b110.pseudocode: pivot=rec[0].position; scan i=1..count-1: if rec[i].position<pivot: m++, swap(rec[i],rec[m]) [double + +8 dword swapped, pad untouched]; swap(rec[0],rec[m]); recurse (rec, m-1) if m>1 and (rec+m+1, count-m-1) if count-m>1

FUN_1000c450.role: vector energy/normalization + autocorrelation window builder for FUN_1000c680
FUN_1000c450.signature: (out_a *i32, out_b *i32, window *i16, vec *i16, n) - called from FUN_1000c680 prologue (0x1000c7b) with c680 locals 0x18/0x1c/0x20 and c680 args (int16 LSF vector, count)
FUN_1000c450.pseudocode: sum2 = sum(vec[i]^2) [64-bit-safe split accumulation: low 15-bit chunks + high chunks]; exponent/mantissa normalization via <=20-iteration bit-scan (test 0x40000, doubling); *out_a/*out_b = the two 32-bit normalization halves (c680 uses them as multipliers); for j in 1..n-1: window[j] = (int16)((sum(vec[i]*vec[i+j]) split-accumulated) >> shift) - normalized autocorrelation taps
FUN_1000c450.note: the lag-parity window TABLES (lag%3==0 -> DAT_10047f10 1536/lag, else DAT_10046f10 2048/lag) are separate factors read by FUN_1000c680 itself

resolved_functions.FUN_1000c680_prologue_facts: comb-shape base = (int)trunc(lag_value * 1/32768 * 32768.0) further truncated to int16 (DAT_1006b440 = 3.0517578125e-05 = 1/2^15) - F-58's scaling description now constant-exact; lag%3 window-table selection confirmed

weight_calibration.application_FUN_10004450: 0x10004461-0x10004484: calib = (int16)(((budget - state[0xec+4*slot]) * state[0xfc+4*slot]) >> 9); w_band = (int16)weight_table[state+0x10c][row*bands+band] + calib; then FUN_10003d80(w_band, ppb)
weight_calibration.base_FUN_1000df10: state[0xec+4*slot] = {x, 3x/2, 3x/2, 2x} for slots 0..3 (truncating signed 3x/2); x = (int16) mode-table scalar: LP-6000 -> int16@0x10038cb0 = 128; LP-other -> int16@0x100390c0 = 128; SP-16000 -> int16@0x100388a0 = 432; the scalars sit immediately after each mode's 64-row band-weight table (F-48's 'short scalar' pairing now attributed = slot-0 base budget)
weight_calibration.slope_FUN_10003e60: state[0xfc+4*slot] = (int)ceil(4194304.0 / (state[0x30+4*slot] * state[0x2c]) + 0.5), clamped to 0 if < 1.0 (ceil = FUN_1000f8e0 = MSVC ceil(); 2^22 double @0x1006b390, +0.5 @0x1006b3a0)
weight_calibration.slot_semantics: slot = FRAME-TYPE slot: 0 = type 0 (both halves), 1 = type 1 AND type 3, 2 = type 2 first region, 3 = type 2 second region (empirically discriminated by SP: per-half mappings stall at <=82.4% closure, frame-type mapping reaches 100%)

positions_per_band.status: empirically pinned; static chain has one unresolved scale factor (honest negative)
positions_per_band.writer: FUN_10003e60 negative-indexed loop ([esi+ebx*4+0x40] with ebx=-4..-1 lands on +0x30..0x3c) - why F-48/F-58 saw no direct writer
positions_per_band.static_chain: state[0x30+4*slot] = trunc(X * local[slot] / 128) * state[0x18]; X = 32 if bitrate <= 6000 else 30; local = {B/4, 3B/8, 3B/8, B/2}, B = state+4 (1024 LP / 2048 SP); state[0x18] = (int)ceil(bitrate * 128.0 / (rate/2 * bands)) [128.0 @0x1006b370]; also state[0x40+4*slot] = ceil(X*local[slot]/(rate/2)+0.5) = {3,4,4,5} LP = initial word-stream offset per slot (band cursors advance cumulatively ppb words per band in FUN_10005d50); state[0x50+4*slot] = ppb*bands + start (word-span end)
positions_per_band.conflict: static chain with state[0x18] = ceil(3504*128/(4000*8)) = 15 (LP-6k) yields ppb {960,1440,1440,1920}, contradicting FUN_10005d50 stack buffers (1026 records / 1024 words -> ppb <= 128) and the natural-cost identity (cost ~= sum(w)*ppb/8192 must ~= budget -> ppb ~= 32 LP / ~50-60 SP)

empirical_effective.note: exactly trunc(X*local[slot]/256) - runtime scale = 1/30 of static first-call for LP-6k; resolution needs the runtime BSS config generator (0x100020d0 chain, statically opaque) or Wine (Q-2)

positions_per_band.buffers: FUN_10005d50 frame 0x51b8: records at ebp-0x5130 (0x4024 B = 1026 x 16 B), words at ebp-0x110c (0x1000 B = 1024 dwords), LSF vec at ebp-0x5180, alloc records at ebp-0x10c, out5 at ebp-0x6c

fixups: sum(p0) parity: if odd, scan bands DECREMENTING BY 1 from last to first (F-58 said stride-2 - corrected), first p0>0 donates p0-=1, p1+=2
sum(p1) %4 (C-trunc): if budget - cost <= 0 drain p1->p2 one unit per band scanning from LAST band down; else grow p2->p1 (4-r units) one unit per band scanning from band 0 up
byte align: f8 = trunc(budget/8)*8; if f8 <= cost drain p2 (bands from end) until cost == f8; else grow p2 single pass bands 0-up in half-remainder steps min((need+1)/2, capacity)

extras: leftover = budget - cost; SKIPPED when leftover <= 0 (jle - a port applying negative extras silently masquerades as closure); else single pass bands 0-up: rec.p3 = min(leftover, n-(p0+p1+p2)), leftover -= until 0; remaining bands p3 = 0
FUN_10004450_complete_algorithm.outputs: out5 = {sum(p0)/2, sum(p1)/4, sum(p2)/8, sum(p3)} (C truncating divisions); return = 4*sum(p0) + 2*sum(p1) + sum(p2) + sum(p3)
FUN_10004450_complete_algorithm.records: allocation records = 16 B {p0, p1, p2, extras} per band (distinct from the 16 B position records that FUN_1000b110 sorts: {double position, int32 word_index})

validation.method: instruction-faithful Python port of FUN_10003d80/FUN_10004450 (incl. extras jle), F-51 parser for framing/budgets/LSF rows, band-weight table read from the PE image at runtime (addresses only committed); dual-LSP frames use their own set's first index as the weight row (single-row rule also closes 100%)
validation.interpretation: the calibration term is DISCRIMINATED by the data: same port, same capacity, only weights change - all 5917 (LP) + 7 (SP) residual raw-weight subframes close under base {x,3x/2,3x/2,2x} with slope ceil(2^22/(ppb*bands)+0.5); alternatives tested and rejected: per-half slot mappings (m1/m5/m6), ppb scales {16..128}-derived, div-512 linear ppb (LP 91-92%, SP <=49.8%)
validation.f58_residual_explained: F-58's 74.2%/62.9% residual was a port artifact (strict leftover-0 accounting + uniform n=32 capacity pressure), not purely the calibration; on the faithful port the raw baseline is 93.75%/97.76% and the calibration closes the rest exactly
